tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "https everywhere, no exceptions": internal hosts get no carve-out, so plain HTTP is not permitted for them and every connection, internal or external, must use HTTPS. Certificate verification also stays on in all builds.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
